_comment: Expected KswordARKLightTests suites and minimum assertion counts for each suite.
Exit codes alone cannot detect a suite omitted from the linked test executable.
HvmEptSwitchTests once contained 344 assertions but was absent from the project;
the process still returned 0 and reported success without running those assertions.
* An expected suite is missing from output -> FAIL, not merely a missing log line.
* Its assertion count is below minAssertions -> FAIL; assertions were removed.
* A new suite appears -> warn so maintainers can register it in this list.
minAssertions records the observed count at registration. Adding assertions needs no update.
Only lower the threshold when assertions are deliberately removed, with an explanation.
